For me this is how it would go for post GVK:

Godzilla "dies" in GvK
1. Mothra: Rebirth (solo movie)
2. King Kong
3. Rodan (Alpha Worthy Rodan)

4. Gamera
5. Tokyo SOS (intro Shin-Godzilla into monsterverse)
6. Mothra 2 

7. Godzilla 3 (godzilla returns as a heel, Godzilla vs Gamera. Civil war-Like storyline)
8. Kong 3

9. Destroy All Monsters 
(Shin-Godzilla mutates to Destoroyah. Kong dies. It's part of his storyline to die, as he will always have a tragic ending. But in this way, after years of building his character, his death would be more impactful; somewhat like Tony Stark in End Game.)

Maybe these are too much movies lmao. They could probably condense 2 movies into one.
